rationale: Price touched $4.85 (the original target) and has since staged only a minor two-candle bounce to $4.90, remaining well below both the 9-EMA ($5.03) and 5-min VWAP ($5.08), which preserves the short-side structural edge. Volume on the bounce candles (172K, 117K) is materially lighter than the entry distribution bar (367K), suggesting the bounce is a low-conviction reaction rather than a genuine reversal. With the invalidation at $5.20 still far away and the intraday downtrend intact, the trade warrants continued holding, though the proximity to the target level warrants close monitoring for a break below $4.85 or acceleration back toward $5.00+.
